appearance.body: A lean, athletic adult male orc warrior: tall compact frame, strong but not bulky shoulders, defined waist and long mobile limbs. Bald scalp, angular olive-green face, pronounced brow, small ivory tusks and focused amber eyes. A short muted crimson neck wrap, one restrained steel shoulder plate, fitted dark iron chest armor and carefully strapped brown leather. Nimble veteran rather than a hulking tank. The silhouette should read as agile and disciplined.
